verdict.rationale: Aircall's API reference documents per-call AI outputs: retrieving a transcription and a summary, plus sentiments and topics. Its marketing says AI Assistants capture notes and update CRM records automatically. However, no evidence shows the transcript and summary are attached to the conversation record that users see in the product. Missing for 10: documentation that summaries and transcripts appear on the call or conversation itself, detail on generation scope (all calls vs. plan-gated), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, calls get AI summaries and transcripts attached to the conversation

citations.quote: Retrieve a transcription ... Retrieve sentiments ... Retrieve topics ... Retrieve a summary
AI Assistants capture notes, update CRM records, and create follow-up tasks automatically
